responsibilities: This role offers a meaningful opportunity to strengthen the risk management frameworks underpinning national family support schemes. You will play a key role in identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across the GPLS, working closely with internal and external stakeholders to uphold the integrity of public schemes. The key responsibilities are as follows. You will also contribute to risk reporting and maintain documentation that supports sound governance and accountability. (b) Risk Assessment and Appeals You will manage the risk assessment phase of the GPLS claims process, reviewing and adjudicating appeals from claimants flagged by the risk detection model. This requires careful evaluation of each case on its merits, sound judgement in determining outcomes, and thorough documentation to ensure decisions are well-supported and defensible. (c) External Audit Oversight You will be responsible for managing appointed external auditors engaged to review the GPLS, ensuring the audit process is conducted effectively and that findings are properly addressed.
